name: Aihole temple-complex village thali stalls
area: Outside the Durga Temple / Aihole monument complex entrance
signature_dish: Home-cooked jolada-rotti village lunch — jola roti, hesaru belle, sagu, majjigai
why_it_matters: Aihole is a small temple village with no formal sit-down restaurant of its own. What it does have is a genuine local foodway: women from the surrounding villages cook a traditional North Karnataka lunch at home every morning and carry it in large aluminium vessels to the monument complex to sell to visitors. It is the most authentic — and only village-based — meal at Aihole, an honest scarcity rather than a restaurant.
insider_tip: Look for a local woman with a big aluminium pot near the temple complex around midday — that is the meal. It is cheap, fresh, and the real North Karnataka village thali. There is no AC restaurant in Aihole; for a sit-down meal, base in Badami (about 35km / 40 minutes by road).
signature_address: Outside the Aihole monument complex entrance, Aihole, Bagalkot District, Karnataka 587124

name: Hotel Paradise Family Restaurant (Badami base — 35km)
area: Station Road, near LIC Office, Badami town centre (35km from Aihole)
signature_dish: Tandoori chicken tikka with North Indian gravies
why_it_matters: Aihole has no AC sit-down restaurant, so visitors doing the Chalukya triangle eat in Badami, the base town ~35km away. Hotel Paradise is currently Badami's top-ranked restaurant on Tripadvisor — a family restaurant near the LIC Office on Station Road serving Indian, Chinese and tandoori — and is the practical full-meal option for an Aihole day trip. Listed here explicitly as a Badami-base row, not an Aihole eatery.
insider_tip: Plan Aihole as a morning visit and lunch in Badami on the way back, or carry a packed meal. The tandoori section at Hotel Paradise is the standout. Badami is about 40 minutes by road from Aihole.
signature_address: Station Road, near LIC Office, Badami town centre, Bagalkot District, Karnataka 587201

name: KSTDC Hotel Mayura Chalukya (Badami base — 35km)
area: Ramdurg Road, near Badami cave temples (35km from Aihole)
signature_dish: Multi-cuisine meals in the government tourism hotel garden
why_it_matters: Tourism listicles often claim a 'KSTDC Hotel Mayura at Aihole' — there is no KSTDC property in Aihole village. The genuine KSTDC Mayura for the Chalukya triangle is Mayura Chalukya in Badami, set in a garden near the cave temples. It is included here as the correct, honestly located Badami-base row for Aihole visitors who want a calm government-hotel meal.
insider_tip: Do not look for a Mayura in Aihole — it does not exist. The real one is in Badami, the overnight base for the whole Aihole-Pattadakal-Badami circuit. Quieter than Badami's Station Road strip; good for a late lunch.
signature_address: Ramdurg Road, near Badami cave temples, Badami, Bagalkot District, Karnataka 587201

name: Geeta Darshini (Badami base — 35km)
area: Main Road, Badami town (35km from Aihole)
signature_dish: Masala dosa and South Indian tiffin
why_it_matters: A pure-veg darshini on Badami's main road — the budget South Indian breakfast anchor for the Chalukya circuit. Listed here as a Badami-base option because Aihole village has no breakfast counter of its own; travellers eat an early dosa in Badami before driving out to the temples.
insider_tip: Best for an early breakfast before the Aihole-Pattadakal drive — go in the morning for the freshest dosa batch. Stand-up or quick-seat, cash-friendly.
signature_address: Main Road, Badami town, Bagalkot District, Karnataka 587201
